# Shared Agreements

## Addresses and ports
| Device | Interface | IP |
|---|---|---|

| Proxy | veth-p | 10.0.1.20/24 |
| R1 (LAN-A side, bridge br0) | br0 | 10.0.1.1/24 |
| R1 (transit side) | veth-r1 | 10.0.12.1/30 |
| R2 (transit side) | veth-r2 | 10.0.12.2/30 |

- Namespace names: client, proxy, r1, r2, origin.

## Test page (generated by server/gen_testpage.py, do not hand-edit)
- Folder: server/www/
- index.html references 20 objects: obj01.dat ... obj20.dat
- Each object is exactly 10240 bytes (10 KB). Total = 21 files (1 page + 20 objects).

## Origin server behaviour the proxy can rely on
- Every 200 response includes: Content-Length, Last-Modified, ETag.
- Supports If-Modified-Since and If-None-Match, returns 304 with no body.
- Supports "Connection: close" and "Connection: keep-alive".

## Proxy log format (tab-separated, one line per request, file: proxy/proxy.log)
ISO_TIMESTAMP <TAB> METHOD <TAB> URL <TAB> RESULT <TAB> STATUS_TO_CLIENT <TAB> BYTES_TO_CLIENT
RESULT is one of: HIT, MISS, REVALIDATE_304, REVALIDATE_200, BYPASS (BYPASS = POST or uncacheable)

## Definitions
- Cache hit ratio = (HIT + REVALIDATE_304) / total GET requests.
- Bytes saved by a 304 = (full 200 response size) - (304 response size), headers included.
